```lean
intro h
split
· intro s a ha
  have : a ∉ s ∪ {a} := by simp [ha]
  rw [insert_eq_union] at this
  exact h s (insert a s) this
· intro h'
  intros s t hs ht
  by_cases h1 : s = t
  · exact le_rfl
  · obtain ⟨a, ha⟩ := set.difference_nonempty (set.diff_eq_iff.1 h1)
    have : a ∉ s := by rwa [set.diff_eq_iff]
    exact h' s (insert a s) (by rwa [insert_eq_union])
```
